summary: Frontend-only smoke test for the new 23 POIs (gazetteer + 3-card copy) on the Ciudades Imperiales 6n/7d program page. All expected NEW monuments/towns appear on the correct day's 'Puntos de interés del día' list; verified rich 3-card galleries open with the new Spanish titles and descriptions for 9 of the new POIs; verified EN translation wires through for Koutoubia. Existing places (Volubilis, Moulay Idriss, Meknes, Marrakech, Rabat, Casablanca, Fez) still appear. No console errors. Xaluca logo renders on the day maps. Maps render markers correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: EXTRA_POIS coords for Habs Qara, Heri es Souani, Mausoleo Moulay Ismail and Bab al Mansour are all clustered around ~33.88,−5.56 (Meknès) which is fine for the day-map but may overlap visually — consider tiny offsets if pin overlap becomes a UX issue.

The day map currently shows the day's POIs at the same zoom, so very dense clusters (Day 6: 7 POIs inside Marrakech medina) will overlap. Consider clustering or a slight jitter when adjacent coords are within ~50 m.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all expected places appear; all 9 sampled new POI cards show the correct new ES copy; EN translation verified

context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-day POI buttons follow data-testid='day-landmark-btn-<dayId>-<poiId>'. Each open carousel uses data-testid='landmark-carousel-<poiId>' with child data-testid='landmark-card-0..2'. IMPORTANT pitfall: opened carousels stay rendered on the page — when sampling card titles, always scope queries to a SPECIFIC landmark-carousel-<id>, otherwise the global querySelector picks up the FIRST opened carousel (which gave a false-negative in my first pass before scoping). Language switcher: data-testid='lang-button-es|en|fr'.
